values.value: Payments can be cash, card, UPI, bank transfer, cheque or online gateway. A payment is allocated to the oldest open invoices of the payer and a receipt is issued. Differences up to {{Setting:Payment_Tolerance}} are accepted as rounding. Anything left over becomes a reconciliation exception that finance resolves; an overpayment is held as credit. Online payment in the family portal is {{Setting:Payment_Gateway_Mode}} (Off means families pay at the branch).
